methods.name: Imitation Learning
methods.description: Learning from human demonstrations to instill intelligent behavioural priors in agents.

methods.name: Self-Supervised Learning
methods.description: Auxiliary training objective used in conjunction with imitation learning to improve performance.

methods.name: Behavioural Cloning (BC)
methods.description: Sequence learning technique used for imitation learning from trajectories of human behaviour.

methods.name: Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning
methods.description: Contrastive representation learning technique involving cross-modality matching between vision and language.

methods.name: Hierarchical Action Selection
methods.description: Architectural technique that improves agent performance, implemented via a hierarchical movement policy.

datasets.name: Playhouse Dataset
datasets.description: Dataset collected in the Playhouse environment comprising 275,676 train episodes and 34,399 test episodes.

concepts.name: MIA (Multimodal Interactive Agent)
concepts.description: A multimodal interactive agent that interacts naturally with humans in a simulated world.

concepts.name: Playhouse
concepts.description: A 3D virtual multi-room environment based on the Unity game engine for studying natural interactions.

concepts.name: Language Games
concepts.description: A collection of prompted interaction-types and free-form instructions centering Playhouse interactions.

findings.name: Agent Success Rate
findings.description: MIA successfully interacts with non-adversarial humans 75% of the time.
